blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Grab Philippines is studying its options after the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) denied GrabBike’s application for accreditation as a motorcycle taxi platform provider (MTTP) for operations outside Metro Manila. In a statement, Grab Philippines said it respected the LTFRB’s decision and was reviewing its options under the board’s rules. “We respect the Board and its mandate, and we are studying the decision and our options under its rules,” the company said.
